reasons.camera: The camera finds stars to see where the telescope points. Pictures stay on this phone.
reasons.location: Your location sets the sky shown. Only the nearest kilometre is kept.
reasons.motion: The motion sensors move the map as you move the telescope.

steps.appleCamera: iPhone Settings › Apps › Safari › Camera › Allow
steps.appleLocation: iPhone Settings › Privacy & Security › Location Services
steps.appleSafariLocation: Safari Websites › While Using the App
steps.appleAllowMotion: Open the app again, and allow motion when asked
steps.androidLocation: Check Location is on in Android Settings
steps.desktopAllow: Click the icon left of the address › {{name}} › Allow

credits.openngc: NGC and IC objects from OpenNGC by Mattia Verga, CC BY-SA 4.0. Converted and filtered for this app.
credits.xhip: Stars, star names and constellation lines from XHIP and the IAU, via d3-celestial.
credits.hyg: Star catalogue names from the HYG Database by David Nash, CC BY-SA 4.0. Converted and filtered for this app.
credits.messier: Messier data by H. Frommert, seds.org, via d3-celestial.
credits.caldwell: Caldwell catalogue compiled by Sir Patrick Moore.
credits.herschel: Herschel 400 selected by the Ancient City Astronomy Club, Herschel II by the Rose City Astronomers, as observed in the Astronomical League's programmes.
credits.sac: 110 Best NGC Objects by A. J. Crayon and Steve Coe, Saguaro Astronomy Club.
credits.rasc: Finest NGC list by Alan Dyer, Royal Astronomical Society of Canada.
credits.gems: Deep-Sky Gems by David H. Levy and Explore the Universe, Royal Astronomical Society of Canada.
credits.assa: Top-100 Deepsky Objects, Astronomical Society of Southern Africa.
credits.hubble: Monthly lists from NASA's Hubble Night Sky Challenge. NASA does not endorse this app.
credits.wds: Double stars from the Washington Double Star Catalog, maintained at the U.S. Naval Observatory.
credits.openMeteo: Weather forecast by Open-Meteo.com, CC BY 4.0, from NOAA's GFS model. Seeing worked out with the AXP model of Trinquet and Vernin.
credits.wmm: Compass correction from the World Magnetic Model, NOAA and the British Geological Survey, via geomagnetism by Natural Atlas, Apache License 2.0.
credits.astronomyEngine: Planets, Pluto, Moon and sky positions by Astronomy Engine, Don Cross.
credits.qr: Pairing codes made with QR Code Generator, Kazuhiko Arase, MIT License, and read with jsQR, Cosmo Wolfe, Apache License 2.0. QR Code is a trademark of DENSO WAVE.
credits.jpl: Orbits of Ceres, Vesta, Pallas and Juno from the NASA/JPL Small-Body Database.
credits.dexie: Log and lists saved with Dexie.js, Copyright (c) 2014-2017 David Fahlander, Apache License 2.0.
credits.falchi: Sky darkness from the New World Atlas of Artificial Night Sky Brightness, Falchi et al., GFZ Data Services, 2016, and Science Advances 2(6) e1600377. CC BY-NC 4.0, non-commercial use only. Averaged and converted for this app.
credits.licences: Software licences of the libraries in the app
